working_question: Can the physical read preserve direct access to unaveraged C values while also using request-associated physical values, instead of forcing every physical read through the serial request bottleneck?
candidate_operator: A single physical attention may read both direct C keys/values and request keys with C-bound values. Native text attention stays a separate unchanged computation. Preserve one zero-value null and the original total relation/null prior; do not double physical mass merely by adding the second memory.
why_it_is_not_yet_accepted: The combined operator has not generated or scored any video. Neither historical endpoint guarantees its mixture succeeds.
B direct PC4.000 belongs to an easier fixed16 subset, not full40. Actual roller/balloon process and shape defects remain in the direct endpoint.
H complete seven16 controls remain pending; their findings can change this proposal.
Independent physicalQ is a possible trainable part, not a proven fix. NativeQ substitution failed to repair H artifacts.
No additional loss, stage, counterfactual labels or new encoder is justified by this hypothesis.
